scope: Retrospective follow-up to the 704 historical proposal records
pairs: Every unordered pair of distinct equal-width supports on the same fold, ordered by archived proposal index
fixed: Development data, refitted anchor and both candidate models, outer feature-row dictionary and outer label sequence. Apply the same permutation of the feature vectors to all three models.
observers: union of empty-restoration queries for both candidates and their common anchor
payoff: Potential compression from passing the outer tolerance, relative to the original fold anchor. This conditions on putting a candidate through to the outer comparison. The historical proposals did not all receive a separate deployment guard.
metrics: Macro one-vs-rest AUC (positive class for binary) and accuracy must both reach 97 percent of the paired refitted anchor, with original slack 1e-12. Average precision was inactive.
report: Record attainable joint pass/fail patterns and the directional utility differences. Preserve unresolved patterns explicitly. No probability law over compatible permutations.
